overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Monaco 6-Person PureTech Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, providing a sanctuary for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and enhanced circulation. With 15 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels and crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it ensures a safe and luxurious experience. Enjoy the added benefits of chromotherapy lighting and integrated entertainment options, making it a standout choice for those seeking both health benefits and modern convenience.
